title: runtime/legacy_labels.json — app-compatibility label map (modern -> legacy Dialogflow contract)
description: Optional. Present only when an app build still consumes the legacy Dialogflow label space. Each native client (iOS/Android) reads this and translates the engine's modern domain.object.action label to the legacy label at its own output boundary; nothing about classification or the model changes. 'confirm_compound' reconstructs dialogue-act labels (e.g. Cmd.SendMessage - yes/no) from a resolved confirmation outcome — those are not model labels.

map.description: modern label -> legacy app label. Passthrough is expected for any label absent here.

confirm_compound.description: intent-under-confirmation -> legacy dialogue-act labels for its yes/no outcome.
